subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Page Object Model
description: A 60-second lesson on Page Object Model.

hook.text: A button selector changes and forty tests break. Each one has the selector hard-coded.

buildup.text: Duplicated selectors scatter across test files, making every UI change a maintenance nightmare.

discovery.text: Page objects centralize selectors and actions for each page into one reusable module.

twist.text: When the button changes, you update one file. All forty tests pass again instantly.

climax.text: UI refactors go from day-long fixes to five-minute updates after adopting page objects.

punchline.text: One source of truth for selectors. Change once, fix all.

quiz.question: What does the Page Object Model centralize?
